title: evidence-binder
description: Structured evidence binder. Indexes one row per artifact assembled for a regulator exam, internal audit, model validation, vendor diligence, or committee review. Reconciles a request list against the evidence on hand and surfaces gaps. Downstream consumers: control-test workpapers, exam-brief, audit-support packs, regulator response files, model-validation evidence packs.

binder_id.description: Stable identifier for the binder. Reused by downstream workpapers, audit support packs, and regulator response files that consume this binder.

engagement_id.description: Optional pointer to the scope record under which this binder was assembled.

binder_purpose.description: What the binder is being assembled for. Drives evidence-ask depth, reviewer expectations, and retention posture.

scope.description: What the binder covers and who it is being prepared for.

entity.description: Legal entity or business unit in scope.

process.description: Process, control area, model, vendor arrangement, or obligation under review.

period_start.description: First date of the period evidence must cover.

period_end.description: Last date of the period evidence must cover.

reviewer.description: Role of the examiner, auditor, validator, or committee receiving the binder. Use a role, not a person.

as_of_date.description: Date the binder was last revised.

source_posture.description: Evidence-access posture set at scope time. Drives what the binder can claim at high confidence vs. what carries [evidence needed].

request_list.description: Examiner request list, audit fieldwork ask, or validator evidence list this binder is reconciled against. Empty when the binder is being assembled outside an external request.

request_id.description: Stable identifier as issued by the requester (e.g., RFI-12, AUDIT-FW-04).

request_text.description: Verbatim request as issued. Do not paraphrase.

status.description: Reconciliation status against the evidence_items index.

linked_evidence_ids.description: evidence_id values that satisfy or partially satisfy this request.

owner_role.description: Role accountable for closing the request.

evidence_items.description: The binder index. One entry per artifact.

evidence_gaps.description: Request items or expected evidence with no artifact, or where the artifact is insufficient.

request_id.description: Optional pointer to the request_list entry the gap addresses.

gap_description.description: What is missing and why it matters.

provenance_concerns.description: Items where the system of record is unclear, the extract method is non-reproducible, or the chain of custody is broken.

custodian_register.description: Roles accountable for evidence integrity by domain. Used to set chain-of-custody when an item is handed from preparer to reviewer to filer.

reviewer_questions.description: Questions the binder surfaces for the reviewer or sponsor. Each ties to a specific gap, provenance concern, or sufficiency call.

sign_off.description: Sponsor / reviewer sign-off. Filled by the human reviewer, not the skill.

confidence_label.description: Sufficiency of the evidence set as a whole, given source posture and the gap-and-provenance picture.

human_review_required.description: Always true. The binder is a draft until a named reviewer signs off.

revision_log.description: Append-only revision history. Each entry records what changed and why.

evidence_id.description: Stable identifier for the artifact within this binder. Persist across revisions.

evidence_type.description: Form of the artifact. management-memo is an assertion not evidence; use only with a paired source-of-record item.

description.description: What the artifact is and what it evidences. Plain language, not a file name.

system_of_record.description: Named system the artifact was pulled from (e.g., 'GRC platform Workiva', 'core banking Fiserv DNA', 'ticketing Jira', 'identity Okta'). Avoid generic labels like 'internal database'.

date_generated.description: When the artifact was produced (run date for a system extract, signature date for an attestation).

period_start.description: First date of the period the artifact covers.

period_end.description: Last date of the period the artifact covers.

linked_issue_ids.description: Pointer into issue-writeup output (when the item is remediation evidence).

custodian_role.description: Named role accountable for the artifact's integrity. Not a team name; not 'Compliance'.

sensitivity.description: Sensitivity classification. restricted typically covers privileged or regulator-confidential content.

provenance.description: How the artifact was extracted and by whom. The chain-of-custody record.

extract_method.description: How the artifact was produced (e.g., 'scheduled SQL extract from data warehouse', 'manual export from GRC UI', 'signed PDF emailed by vendor').

extracted_by_role.description: Role of the person who pulled the artifact.

system_of_record_link.description: Direct pointer back to the source-of-record record (URL, record ID, file path). Required when evidence_type is system-screenshot.

reproducible.description: Can a reviewer re-run the extract from the same source and get the same artifact?

completeness_flag.description: Sufficiency for the request or control it supports.

completeness_notes.description: What is missing or partial about this artifact.

evidence_class.description: Separates evidence from assertion from inference. The binder shows the seams; do not collapse classes.

reviewer_signoff.description: Review attestation for this specific artifact (where the reviewer signs at the row, not just the binder).
